source.title: Construction of Proposed Elevated Corridor from Sarjapura Junction to Electronic City Flyover integrating Ejipura Flyover, Madiwala Underpass, St. John Junction and Silk Board Junction - Schedules A, B, C, D, F, H & I
source.status: Tender purpose only; drawings dated 21-10-2026. Chainages may change in the final design.
source.file: docs/Ejipura to Silk Board Schedule A B C D F H I.pdf
source.traffic_file: docs/OD and Toll Analysis OMR to Silk Board.pdf

chainage_note: Contract chainage 0 = Sarjapura Road junction (our Junction A); 458 m = Madivala Underpass T-junction (our Junction B). LHS/RHS read as left/right looking from A towards B, i.e. LHS = SE side, RHS = NW side.

inventory.ref: Schedule A, Annex I - chainage-wise carriageway inventory (rows 112-116)

rows.note: Recorded as a single 24.4 m carriageway; the typical drawing at 330 m shows 11 + 0.6 + 11 m.

inventory.drains: RCC covered drains on both sides along 0-400 m

re_wall.ref: Schedule A, item 19 - existing RE wall
re_wall.note: Reinforced-earth approach of the Ejipura flyover, on the Madivala underpass side. A solid earth-filled wall in the middle of the road - nobody can cross through it.

ramp.ref: Schedule B, ix (Ramps) and xi (cross-section table, row 1)
ramp.note: Up-ramp to Silk Board from Sarjapura Road: 110 m viaduct + 80 m approach (RE wall, TCS-17).

viaduct.note: Split flyover Ejipura to Madivala rotary, LHS + RHS, 8.5 m each, 5.5 m above the at-grade road. Elevated rotary at Madivala junction.

pedestrian_provisions.ref: Schedule B x, Schedule C (pedestrian facilities, bus bays)
items: Raised pedestrian crossings at each junction (locations to be approved by the Authority Engineer)
Bus shelters on the project highway: Nil

items.title: Contract text (Schedule B)
items.ref: Schedule B, 4(ii) - at-grade formation 18 m: 3.0 footpath + 1.5 buffer + 2 x 4.5 carriageway + 1.5 + 3.0. The text does not say how these 18 m sit within the ~30 m right-of-way or around the piers.

items.title: Tactical trial option (to test)
items.ref: Existing kerbs kept. Cones/barricades and paint test a 7 m carriageway per direction (2 x 3.5 m, IRC), a 2 m footpath extension and 2 m kerbside bays for bus stops, vending or parking (DULT Siddaiah Road approach).
